project.name: Violet Parfumerie
project.goal: Strengthen the image-led editorial fragrance experience and make browser-to-Figma media transport reliable without regressing into a generic marketplace.

principles: trial stays adjacent to purchase decisions

layout_rules: first major Home/PDP composition targets roughly 70% media and 30% copy-commerce
white and warm-paper canvas with pastel violet as focal identity cue
Object → Material → Atmosphere is the recurring media sequence
media_rules: buyer-facing fragrance/editorial media must resolve from same-origin repository assets
remote source URLs live only in the provenance manifest
Figma capture mode forces media eager and removes non-essential motion/filter/transform effects
supporting imagery must not be represented as a fictional product packshot
